replace_with_fp8_linear: replace all torch.nn.Linear modules in a model with FP8Linear modules for fine-grained FP8 quantization
create_FP8Linear: create an FP8Linear layer that performs FP8 matrix multiplication with per-tensor or block-wise quantization
create_FP8Experts: create an FP8Experts module for MoE models with FP8-quantized expert feed-forward layers
quantize_weights_fp8: quantize a weight tensor to float8_e4m3fn using per-tile block-wise quantization with inverse scales
dequantize_fp8_weights: dequantize FP8 weights and inverse scales back to full precision float32 tensor
